body:
I higly suspect https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/857cda2c45a5cc68c3fa398311c48c571a64915d

This wasn't caught earlier because the JDK7 build breakage was preventing downstream project from being built

Broken builds because jenkins cannot show them easily:
http://ci.bazel.io/job/rules_closure/55/
http://ci.bazel.io/job/rules_scala/79/
http://ci.bazel.io/job/skydoc/8/
http://ci.bazel.io/job/TensorFlow/179/
http://ci.bazel.io/job/TensorFlow_Serving/60/
http://ci.bazel.io/job/Tutorial/243/
Verifying now, but I think this is caused by the SourceManifestAction caching issue, which I've got an LGTM'd CL to fix.

Yup, that's it!  

Note that this won't fix everything, I think the AppEngine rules are just broken because they assume an empty workspace name.  But it should be much better.
the appengine rules where not broken by that change
Well, they should have been. Guess they're not very well tested.
http://ci.bazel.io/job/skydoc/BAZEL_VERSION=HEAD,PLATFORM_NAME=linux-x86_64/11/console at least one breakage left. ci is still running :(
TensorFlow tests are still failing :( I need to go home now and probably will be offline. Feel free to push if you have more fixes for that.

Happily, the TF failure looks like a flake (it passes for me locally).  However, I'm not sure why the other tests are failing, so I'm rolling back.  The failing tests are now:
- [TF Serving](http://ci.bazel.io/job/TensorFlow_Serving/63/BAZEL_VERSION=HEAD,PLATFORM_NAME=linux-x86_64/console)
- [SkyDoc](http://ci.bazel.io/job/skydoc/BAZEL_VERSION=HEAD,PLATFORM_NAME=linux-x86_64/11/console) - I couldn't actually figure out how to get to this failure.
- [Tutorial](http://ci.bazel.io/job/Tutorial/PLATFORM_NAME=linux-x86_64/246/console) - android rules are accessing the wrong path.
- [rules_rust](http://ci.bazel.io/job/rules_rust/BAZEL_VERSION=HEAD,PLATFORM_NAME=linux-x86_64/43/console)
- [rules_closure](http://ci.bazel.io/job/rules_closure/55/BAZEL_VERSION=HEAD,PLATFORM_NAME=linux-x86_64/console)
